annotations.title: Create a JsonFabrica batch generation job

description: Calls POST /v1/batches. Generates multiple documents from one or more persisted templates in one call, optionally cross-referencing documents via `relations` — use this instead of looping jsonfabrica_generate_from_template yourself when you need many documents or cross-document relations in a single request. Small batches run synchronously and the response is 200 with `results`; larger batches are queued and the response is 202 with just `{ batchId, status, seed }` — poll jsonfabrica_get_batch for the final results in that case. Like a single generate call, this is metered/billed per document produced and, unless namespaced, can advance real durable sequences and mutate durable variables referenced by the templates.

documents.description: One entry per group of documents to generate, each naming a `templateId`, a unique `alias`, how many (`count`) to generate, and optionally `relations`/`params`. Required; at least one entry. Entries are executed in dependency order (documents with `relations` are generated after the aliases they depend on).

alias.description: Short name identifying this `documents[]` entry within the batch, used to reference it from other entries' `relations` (and duplicated aliases across entries are rejected with a 400 error). Required.

count.description: How many documents to generate from this template within the batch. Required; must be an integer.

params.description: Key/value map supplying values for getParam("key") placeholders in this template's body, applied to every document generated for this alias. Optional; omitted keys leave the corresponding getParam() calls unresolved/empty.

anyOf.description: Shorthand relation reference in the form "parentAlias" or "parentAlias.field.nested", pointing at a document from another `documents[]` entry (by its `alias`). Only valid when the referenced parent has `count === 1` — with `count > 1` the reference is ambiguous and the request is rejected with a 400 error; use the object form with `strategy` instead.

from.description: Same "parentAlias" or "parentAlias.field.nested" reference as the string form, but required here so a `strategy` can be attached — used when the referenced parent has `count > 1`.

strategy.description: How to pick one of several parent documents when the referenced alias has `count > 1`. Only "round-robin" is currently supported (cycles through the parent's generated documents in order, wrapping around); any other value is rejected with a 400 UNSUPPORTED_STRATEGY error. Optional, but effectively required whenever the parent alias has `count > 1`.

relations.description: Map of field name (as it appears in this template's generated output) to a reference into another alias in the same batch, letting generated documents cross-reference each other (e.g. an "orders" entry referencing a "customers" entry's id). Optional; omit for documents with no cross-references. Unknown aliases or dependency cycles across `documents[]` are rejected with a 400 error.

templateId.description: ID of the persisted template used to generate this document group. Required.

seed.description: Deterministic PRNG seed applied across the whole batch — the same seed reproduces byte-identical random values for every document. Optional; if omitted the server picks a random seed and returns it in the response (`seed` in both sync and async cases).

sequenceNamespace.description: Isolates createSeq()/getSeq() durable-sequence side effects for this whole batch under this namespace, so test/debug runs don't advance real tenant sequences. Optional; omitted means the default (unnamespaced) sequence scope is used.

variableNamespace.description: Isolates durable-variable side effects for this whole batch under this namespace, analogous to `sequenceNamespace`. Optional; omitted means the default (unnamespaced) variable scope is used.

name: jsonfabrica_create_batch

error.description: Present if the whole batch failed.

alias.description: The `documents[]` alias this document was generated for.

batchId.description: Id of the batch this document belongs to.

result.description: The generated document; shape depends on the template body. Absent while pending/failed.

seqNo.description: 0-based index of this document within its alias group.

templateId.description: Template used to generate this document.

seed.description: PRNG seed used/assigned for the whole batch.
